doc: Guardrail-owned paths and required gates. A commit that changes a guardrail path must belong to a work item whose scope manifest (architecture/work-scopes/WI-####.json) declares "guardrail": true. Feature work is not authority to change its supervisor (kemiller2002/limen#51 §11). Checked by scripts/check-scope.ts; required gates are checked by test/guardrails.test.ts.

legacyWorkItems.doc: Work items completed on this branch before scope manifests existed. Their manifests were recorded after the fact from the scope each declared in its ROS work-item description; no later work item may use this exemption.

unsafeAbiCrates.doc: The only Rust guest crates allowed to use unsafe code: WebAssembly ABI shims with no decision, state or decoding of their own. Each must carry the JUSTIFIED UNSAFE BOUNDARY comment and still deny warnings.

warningsNotAsErrors.doc: The only warnings a guest project may keep from failing its build. Each entry names one project and exact warning ids, links the owner's decision, and says why. Guest projects may not use NoWarn or --nowarn at all, and may use WarningsNotAsErrors only exactly as listed here; a listed warning still prints. Checked by test/guardrails.test.ts.

entries.reason: FSharp.Core's own embedded trimming file asks the trimmer to remove resources the assembly does not contain, in every version from 8.0.102 to 10.0.112 (docs/27). It is a packaging fault in FSharp.Core, not a trim-safety finding; every trim-analysis warning stays an error.
